text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text: Haa... haa...

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
...Yes! 
I'm alright...!

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text: I can still... I can still keep running!

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
...You survived. 
Daring Tact.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: Truly—a remarkably strong girl.

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text: (Clap clap clap clap...!)

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
Ah... 
...Are they saying, 'Welcome back'?

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
Thank you, everyone! 
—Thank you so much...!

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
Phew... Daring Tact, thank goodness...! 
She's back...
choice_data_list:
(...It really hits you right in the 
heart.)

(...It really hits you right in the 
heart.)

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Her first race back from rest. In a 
demanding GⅠ arena, 
Daring Tact gave it everything she 
currently had. 
She delivered a truly magnificent run.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Just seeing her standing on the turf—that 
alone 
was enough to bring joy to countless fans. 
But 
we couldn't be satisfied with just that.
choice_data_list:
(We have to show them an even greater 
dream...!)

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text: Trainer—
choice_data_list:
How are your legs? Everything feeling 
alright?

How are your legs? Everything feeling 
alright?

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text: Ah, y-yes... I'm alright.
choice_data_list:
Good. Once you catch your breath, let's 
get you checked out.

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
Yes, please do. 
...Hehe.

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
You're right, checking my physical 
condition comes first... 
especially since I've only just returned.

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
Still, I really am fine. 
My new form feels so natural now... 
It felt almost magically light while 
running.

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
Even so, I don't consider today my 
complete comeback. 
Because—
choice_data_list:
Because we're going to show them an even 
bigger dream!

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
Yes! 
So—let's decide on our next objective.

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
If we want to deliver that dream, our 
sights should surely be on... 
the Takarazuka Kinen, shouldn't they?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The Takarazuka Kinen is the Spring Grand 
Prix. 
A race decided largely by fan voting, 
nothing could embody the word "dream" more 
fittingly.

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
Today, I think the primary feeling was 
just relief that I made my return. 
However...

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
At the Takarazuka Kinen, I want to go 
beyond that... 
and show them a truly strong version of 
myself!
choice_data_list:
Right, let's take it on—the Takarazuka 
Kinen!

Right, let's take it on—the Takarazuka 
Kinen!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And with that, 
our next race was decided: the Takarazuka 
Kinen.

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
—Oh? 
Could that be...

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text: Titleholder!

text_block_list.name: Titleholder
text_block_list.text: ...Daring Tact.

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
You came. 
Were you... watching the race?

text_block_list.name: Titleholder
text_block_list.text: ...Of course. I came to see your race.

text_block_list.name: Titleholder
text_block_list.text:
............Would you mind if I walked 
back with you?

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
! 
Not at all!

text_block_list.name: Titleholder
text_block_list.text:
I see. 
Your next goal—the Takarazuka Kinen.

text_block_list.name: Titleholder
text_block_list.text: Then we'll be clashing against each other.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Titleholder is a rising star drawing 
massive attention right now. 
Just like Daring Tact, the strength she 
forged in nature 
is the genuine article.
choice_data_list:
(I see, a new wave is already 
cresting...!)

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
...I see. 
Finally, against you, Titleholder...

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
It takes me back. When we were little, 
we used to run together all the time.

text_block_list.name: Titleholder
text_block_list.text:
You were always strong. 
...Always one step ahead of me.

text_block_list.name: Titleholder
text_block_list.text:
Back then, anyway. 
—Now, things are different.

text_block_list.name: Titleholder
text_block_list.text:
Daring Tact, I've grown stronger. 
Strong enough to surpass you.

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text: ...Titleholder.

text_block_list.name: Titleholder
text_block_list.text:
I was always watching. Your battles... 
everything you kept honing to perfection.

text_block_list.name: Titleholder
text_block_list.text:
I knew that even if you got hurt, you'd 
come back. 
I was certain of that, too.

text_block_list.name: Titleholder
text_block_list.text:
—And you proved me right. 
Tell me, Daring Tact.

text_block_list.name: Titleholder
text_block_list.text:
I will face you at your best, with 
everything I have. 
...Deal?

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
No deal. 
Because I'm going to beat you.

text_block_list.name: Titleholder
text_block_list.text: No, I will.

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text: No, it'll be me.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Fired up by the appearance of a new rival, 
Daring Tact was ready. To showcase that 
great dream 
at the Takarazuka Kinen—there could be no 
better opponent.
